tools.name: list_hospitals
tools.description: Returns the hospitals supported by the medprice.ai API, with their hospital_id (opaque DB key), EIN, name, locations, and last_updated_on. Supports pagination.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_hospital_chargemaster_cost" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "list_hospitals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the hospitals supported by the medprice.ai API, with their hospital_id (opaque DB key), EIN, name, locations, and last_updated_on. Supports pagination." → after: "Returns the hospitals supported by the medprice.ai API, with their hospital_id (opaque DB key), EIN, name, locations, last_updated_on, and revision history (with per-revision has_payer_data). Supports pagination."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
